prompts.mushrooms: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one sprite sheet for the existing Magikitos 2.5D woodland adventure. Make SIX separate small mushroom CLUSTERS arranged in an evenly spaced 3 columns by 2 rows grid, transparent background and generous fully transparent gutters. View every cluster from the SAME elevated 3/4 angle, showing stems and fronts of caps, not overhead. Top row: exactly TWO mushrooms per cell: left two chestnut brown porcini with pale stout stems; middle two golden chanterelles with wavy caps; right two warm russet saffron milkcaps. Bottom row: exactly THREE mushrooms per cell of the same species as the column above. Every individual cap and stem must be clearly countable, separated in silhouette; no extra baby mushrooms. Fine detailed matte hand-painted pixel-art, sharp deliberate microtexture, warm woodland light from upper left, natural modest saturation, beautiful organic silhouettes. Sparse tiny moss only where stems meet ground, no large dirt discs or painted grass plates. Not glossy, not 3D plastic, not giant square pixels. No text, no labels, no border, no decorations outside the six clusters. These are small forage props in a game, not houses; each trio is wider rather than three times taller. No dew drops. Fully complete silhouettes, never clipped. Output the single six-cell sheet with real alpha.
prompts.balance: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent world-object sprite for Magikitos, a detailed matte woodland pixel-art 2.5D adventure with tiny mischievous elves. A beautiful freestanding two-pan balance scale hand-built by forest elves from crooked carved hazel branches, braided flax suspension cords and two shallow acorn-shell dishes, a small aged brass pivot. One small mushroom in each pan, a carved mushroom motif in the central upright but NO letters or numbers. On a low sturdy irregular mossy tree-stump plinth; whimsical, charming, readable silhouette. Both pans visible and roughly level. Elevated three-quarter game camera, looking slightly down so we see upper surfaces AND the front of the stump, NOT vertical overhead, NOT isometric diamond base. Fine crisp painterly pixel detail, natural warm daylight from upper left, woodland green/brass/honey wood colors. Matte textures, no plastic glossy shine. Real transparent background around the entire single prop, no floor plane or scenery. Full silhouette with margin on every edge, no crop, no text, no UI, no characters. This is a magical opinions-weighing balance placed beside a forest tavern; it should be instantly recognizable as a balance. Substantial horizontal bar, clear open space beneath each suspended pan. Keep ornament economical and expertly crafted, not cluttered.
prompts.forest: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one sprite sheet of FOUR finite forest-edge modules for a rich woodland 2.5D adventure. Transparent background. 2 columns by 2 rows equal grid, wide transparent gutters. IMPORTANT perspective: view from elevated 3/4 game camera about 35 degrees down from horizontal, trees stand UPRIGHT in every cell, visible front bark and small grounded trunks below full crowns, not aerial blobs, not a top-down hedge. Fine detailed matte pixel illustration, many distinct leaf clusters, warm upper-left daylight, moss green and yellow-green highlights, rich dark under-canopy spaces. Every module is a densely joined group of 3-5 small mature trees and low ferns, no gaps through its base, naturally tapered ends with smaller bushes. Top left: long horizontal grouping of oaks; top right: shorter horizontal grouping of hornbeams with a distinctive pale curved trunk. Bottom left: a receding north-south strip of trees (screen vertical), each tree still seen from the same front elevated angle; bottom right: shorter receding vertical strip of birches and hornbeams. No frame, no ring, no cut tile edges. Each grouping COMPLETE and ISOLATED, soft natural endpoints on both ends, no cut branches. No large soil plate. No dew, no text, no labels, no buildings, no characters. Camera and scale identical across modules; crisp well-defined natural art, not blurry, not huge square pixels, not generic vector bushes. Real alpha.
prompts.corners: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one sprite sheet of FOUR curved forest boundary corners for a lush woodland 2.5D adventure, transparent background. 2x2 equally spaced grid with wide transparent gutters. Four SEPARATE complete L-shaped groves of closely joined broadleaf trees with visible trunks and front bark, moss and ferns underneath. Top-left has its empty inner walking area towards BOTTOM RIGHT (north-west outer corner). Top-right opens towards BOTTOM LEFT. Bottom-left opens towards TOP RIGHT. Bottom-right opens towards TOP LEFT. Each is a cohesive organically curved grove, not two overlapping rectangular strips. Camera always elevated three-quarter about 35 degrees down from horizontal: every TREE stands upright on screen, crowns above trunks regardless of L orientation. NOT vertical overhead, NOT aerial green blobs. Front trees occlude rear trees naturally. Branches leafy in varied moss/olive/gold greens with deeply shaded lower foliage and small warm brown exposed trunks; meticulous matte hand-painted pixel-art texture, crisp fine details, subtle warm upper-left light. Rounded tree crowns taper into smaller ferns at the two tips of each L, with fully drawn uncut endpoints and no ground disc. No fixed enclosing square border. Keep the inside cavity open, do not fill the L into a solid square. No characters, text, signs, dew, houses, shadows outside silhouette. Actual transparent background, ample clear margins.
